description: This file declares the interface for a helper class, IAVBufferHelper, used for managing memory buffers via handles. It includes method declarations for mapping, unmapping, retrieving size, writing data, and copying data between secure buffers, along with a factory function to obtain an instance of the helper.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: An interface class providing methods for managing buffer handles, including mapping, unmapping, size retrieval, secure writing, and copying buffers.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from a given handle, returning a pointer to the mapped memory and its size.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps memory associated with a handle, returning true if successful.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of memory allocated for a given handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure buffer associated with a handle; has a default implementation returning false.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data from one secure buffer to another, guided by a map of offsets and sizes; defaults to returning false.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
